mapper.select: SELECT c.committee_id AS committeeId, c.tender_id AS tenderId, t.tender_name AS tenderName, c.committee_code AS committeeCode, c.committee_name AS committeeName, c.evaluation_method AS evaluationMethod, c.evaluation_location AS evaluationLocation, c.evaluation_start_time AS evaluationStartTime, c.evaluation_end_time AS evaluationEndTime, c.status AS status, d.user_name AS evaluationDirectorName, s.user_name AS supervisorName, u.user_name AS createdByName, c.created_time AS createdTime FROM exp_bid_evaluation_committee c LEFT JOIN exp_tender t ON c.tender_id = t.tender_id LEFT JOIN exp_user d ON c.evaluation_director_id = d.user_id LEFT JOIN exp_user s ON c.supervisor_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN exp_user u ON c.created_by = u.user_id WHERE c.committee_id = #{committeeId}
